_about: Rules for scripts/bill_watch.mjs. A bill is watched when it amends a listed statute, its summary uses a listed phrase, or its number is in 'always'. Numbers in 'never' are skipped. 'platform' links a match to the 2026-2027 IAASE Legislative Platform (adopted Oct 21, 2026) or to an item on the IAASE Advocacy & Public Policy Committee's Oct 7, 2026 agenda. A link is context for the committee, not a position. A rule with 'field': 'title' is a regular expression checked against the short title ILGA gives the bill. Edit freely; the next daily run applies the change.

platformItems.P1: IAASE Priority 1: Equitable funding across educational settings (placement-neutral funding, SB3606)
platformItems.P2: IAASE Priority 2: Fully fund services for students with the most significant needs (Fund Code X)
platformItems.P3: IAASE Priority 3: Make IEPs clearer and more useful
platformItems.P4: IAASE Priority 4: Build and sustain the special education workforce
platformItems.C504: Committee watch item: Section 504 bills (IAASE is working with IASB to prepare a defense)
platformItems.CADV: Committee watch item: standards for special education advocates (committee wants IAASE to pursue)
